prompt.en:
Before sign-off, review the files:
1. @Requirement Package
2. API documentation at http://172.16.42.18:8082/langhub-crm/swagger-ui/index.html
3. connected postgresql database
Perform a requirements consistency review. Identify contradictions, ambiguities, missing requirements, data mismatches, and traceability gaps.
Summarize the key findings and open questions requiring clarification
prompt.zh:
签署前，请审阅以下内容：
1. @Requirement Package
2. API 文档：http://172.16.42.18:8082/langhub-crm/swagger-ui/index.html
3. 已连接的 postgresql 数据库
请做一次需求一致性审查，识别其中的矛盾、歧义、缺失需求、数据不匹配和可追溯性缺口。
总结关键发现和需要澄清的开放问题

reply.en: Found several contradictions, ambiguities, and traceability gaps across the requirement package, API, and database schema — details and open questions below.
reply.zh: 在需求包、API 和数据库表结构之间发现了若干矛盾、歧义和可追溯性缺口，详情和待澄清问题见下方。

caption.en: Consistency check findings and open questions
caption.zh: 一致性校验发现与待澄清问题
